label: Stripe Connect
description: Connect CMS users to Stripe connected accounts and destination-charge payments.

instructions: Create or reuse a Stripe platform account and copy its restricted or secret key.
Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Install the Stripe Connect source and backoffice dashboard with the deployed function URL.
scopes: Backoffice connected account and payment dashboards
checks: The browser never receives the Stripe secret key.
The CMS only stores the source configuration and secret references.
Each user-facing request forwards x-user-id from the authenticated CMS subject.
Dashboard reads remain behind CMS gateway permissions.
The connector deployer owns Supabase project credentials.
resources: Stripe Connect accounts and payments dashboard
Embedded onboarding bloc for connected users
Stripe secret key and private CMS API key
Private stripe_connect schema and Edge Function
review: Use a restricted Stripe key when possible.
Do not expose Stripe secret keys to the CMS browser bundle.
Add Stripe webhooks before relying on payment state as a settlement source of truth.
Review Stripe Connect fraud and platform-loss responsibilities before going live.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a CMS source backed by a Supabase Edge Function. Supabase stores connector state; Stripe owns connected accounts and payments.
